reason: The v2 planning contract advertises causal-order, complete-join, and arm-write-set enforcement that the current compiler does not mechanically establish. In particular, generated raw D is constructed from the complete IR write set even though its frozen semantics require the SAFE-MIX posterior to remain unchanged.
replacement_prerequisites: Verify the paired causal-closure artifact with tools/gamma_mechanism_causal_closure_verify.py.
Make the successor compiler consume the verified per-arm event access and write sets rather than hard-coded state identifiers.
Require raw D to exclude every mechanism-persistent mixture state while mixed M writes each declared mixture state.
Require K, M, R, and S to have identical declared read/write access sets.
Require byte-64 join closure to retain every authoritative state, discard every ephemeral/evidence state, and forbid every ephemeral-to-parent copy.
Run independent deterministic compiler A/B output comparison and frozen negative controls before granting execution authority.
activation_rule: No generated Mechanism IR arm or control may execute until a correction-only compiler consumes a verified causal closure and receives a deterministic independent-build verification receipt.
historical_preservation_rule: Preserve the affected planning contract, compiler, and realization byte-for-byte as pre-execution design history; do not infer a scientific or compression result from this supersession.
